# Genesis Apocryphon Column 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 22 | **Condition:** Well preserved; substantially legible

---

**22:1** And-he-set before-her Hagar as-a-handmaid.

**22:2** And-the-king gave to-me much silver and-much-gold and-much clothing

**22:3** and-fine-linen and-purple, and-he-set-them before-me,

**22:4** and-Hagar also he-gave to-her as-a-handmaid.

**22:5** And-I, Abram, went-out with-very-great-flocks and-also with-silver and-gold.

**22:6** I-went-up from-Egypt, I and-all my-household,

**22:7** and-Lot went with-me. And-Lot also had-gained much-livestock

**22:8** and-had-taken for-himself a-wife from-among-the-daughters of-Egypt.

**22:9** And-I-encamped [...] in-every-place of-my-encampments until I-came to-Bethel,

**22:10** the-place where I-had-built the-altar formerly.

**22:11** And-I-built-it-again and-I-offered upon-it burnt-offerings and-a-grain-offering

**22:12** to-the-God Most-High. And-I-called upon-the-name of-the-LORD there

**22:13** and-I-praised-God, and-I-said: You, O-God Most-High, are my-God forever and-ever.

**22:14** And-I-went from-there [...] southward [...] until I-came to-Hebron.

**22:15** And-Hebron was-built at-that-time. And-I-dwelt there two-years.

**22:16** Now there-was a-famine in-all-this-land, and-I-heard that-there-was grain

**22:17** in-Egypt. And-I-went to-go to-the-land of-Egypt [...]

**22:18** And-I-came to-the-river Karmon, one of-the-branches of-the-River,

**22:19** [...] and-now I-crossed [...] the-seven-branches of-this-river [...]

**22:20** And-I-passed-through our-land and-I-crossed the-breadth of [...]

**22:21** and-I-crossed the-border of-Egypt.

**22:22** And-God said to-me: Look from-the-place where you-are,

**22:23** northward and-southward and-eastward and-westward,

**22:24** for-all the-land which you-see — to-you I-shall-give-it

**22:25** and-to-your-seed forever.

**22:26** And-I-made-your-seed as-the-dust of-the-earth, so-that-if a-man can-count

**22:27** the-dust of-the-earth, then your-seed also shall-be-counted.

**22:28** Rise-up, walk-about in-the-land, to-its-length and-to-its-breadth,

**22:29** for-to-you I-shall-give-it. And-I, Abram, went traveling to-go-about

**22:30** and-to-see the-land. And-I-began to-travel from-the-river Gihon

**22:31** and-I-came along-the-sea until I-reached the-mountain of-the-Bull.

**22:32** And-I-traveled from [...] the-Great-Salt-Sea and-I-went along the-mountain of-the-Bull

**22:33** eastward through-the-breadth of-the-land until I-came to-the-river Euphrates.

**22:34** And-I-traveled along-the-Euphrates until I-reached the-Red-Sea in-the-east.

---

*EMET notes: Column 22 is well preserved and narrates the departure from Egypt and return to Canaan. The gift of Hagar (22:1, 22:4) is mentioned twice, possibly reflecting different source layers. Lot's Egyptian wife (22:8) is a detail not found in Genesis. The divine promise (22:22-27) parallels Gen 13:14-17. The geographical survey (22:30-34) reprises the journey of Column 19. "The mountain of the Bull" is Mount Taurus. Construct chains preserved with hyphens throughout.*
